source.note: A new file, not a copy scored differently: benchmarks/competitive/CONTROLS.json's start_commit, token_budget and intervention_budget are each a single value for ONE fixture. evad-family holds three independent fixtures, each needing its OWN frozen start commit and its own budgets, so those three fields are per-task maps here instead. RUBRIC.md itself is reused unmodified: none of its six dimensions read anything task-specific, they only read diff.patch/meta.json against whatever --fixture directory is passed.

gate_before_use: Same gate as the competitive round: no new benchmark work until the P0 rows on docs/plan/READINESS-ROADMAP-2026-08-29.json close, per docs/plan/FIX-DIRECTIVE-2026-09-06.md section 31.
model_id: NO-DATA: named once, identical across every competitor arm and every task, by whoever runs the round; write the exact id here before the round starts.

task1-cache-invalidation.start_commit: NO-DATA: produced by this task's own TASK.md Setup section; a session must run it and record the hash it prints here.
task1-cache-invalidation.token_budget: NO-DATA: named once per round, identical across every arm, before the round starts.
task1-cache-invalidation.intervention_budget: NO-DATA: named once per round, identical across every arm, before the round starts.

task2-chunk-boundary.token_budget: NO-DATA: named once per round, identical across every arm, before the round starts.
task2-chunk-boundary.intervention_budget: NO-DATA: named once per round, identical across every arm, before the round starts.

scoring_note: scripts/competitive_score.py reads token_budget and intervention_budget as flat top-level CONTROLS.json fields, not nested under tasks. When scoring a run for a given task, pass that task's own numbers with a per-task controls file (or invoke the script once per task with a shell substitution), never the whole tasks map: --controls does not know about the tasks key above, it only reads token_budget/intervention_budget directly.

machine.how_to_capture: uname -a; on macOS also sysctl -n machdep.cpu.brand_string hw.ncpu hw.memsize; on Linux also lscpu and free -h. Record the actual command output beside the run record, never assumed from a prior round.

competitors: NO-DATA: same four frameworks plus vanilla Claude Code as benchmarks/competitive/CONTROLS.json's competitors block; copy that block verbatim into this file, re-verified against this machine's ~/.claude/plugins/known_marketplaces.json, before the round starts rather than assuming it is still current.

raw_artifacts.convention: One run directory per competitor arm PER TASK, contract documented in benchmarks/competitive/RUBRIC.md: diff.patch, meta.json (declared_files, tokens_used, interventions), optionally receipt.json and transcript.txt.
raw_artifacts.root: NO-DATA: named per round; a dated directory under benchmarks/results/ following the existing benchmarks/results/long-horizon-recovery/ convention is the closest sibling on this estate, with one subdirectory per task.

publish_rule: Same as the competitive round: publish raw artifacts, never only a composite score. scripts/competitive_score.py enforces this mechanically per task.
